Package com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in.http

Class KfeChannelAdminController

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in.http.KfeChannelAdminController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/admin/kfe/channels") public class KfeChannelAdminController extends Object
Administrative HTTP facade for channel state, decisions, and asynchronous capacity/rebalance workers.

    • KfeChannelAdminController

      public KfeChannelAdminController(KfeChannelLifecycleService channelLifecycleService, KfeChannelRebalanceWorker rebalanceWorker, KfeChannelCapacityQueueService capacityQueue, KfeChannelCapacityWorker capacityWorker, KfeChannelCapacityController capacityController, KfeCapacitySignalStore capacitySignals)
      Creates the admin facade with lifecycle, queue, worker, and signal collaborators.
      Parameters:
      channelLifecycleService - channel decisions and lifecycle operations
      rebalanceWorker - rebalance queue worker
      capacityQueue - capacity intent queue reader
      capacityWorker - capacity intent worker
      capacityController - signal-driven capacity scanner
      capacitySignals - in-process capacity signal accumulator
